title: Best AI Writing Tools for Small Business 2026: Top 6 Ranked & Reviewed

facts.fact: CostBench lists a typical budget for AI writing tools for small business of $9–$499 per month.
CostBench lists Rytr as having a free plan with paid plans at $9–$49 per month.
facts.quote: Rytr is our top pick for small business AI Writing Tools at a free plan, then paid plans at $9–$49/mo.

facts.fact: CostBench lists Sudowrite pricing at $19–$59 per month.
facts.quote: Sudowrite is our top pick for small business AI Writing Tools at $19–$59/mo.

facts.quote: Wordtune is our top pick for small business AI Writing Tools at a free plan, then paid plans at $13.99–$19.99/mo.
